const j = $json;
return {
  json: {
    run_id: $('Compute Run Context').first().json.run_id,
    target_date: $('Compute Run Context').first().json.target_date,
    account_id: j.Account_ID || null,
    brand_id: j.Brand_ID || null,
    brand_name: j.Brand_Name || null,
    platform: j.Platform || null,
    account_type: j.Account_Type || null,
    platform_account_id: j.Platform_Account_ID || null,
    followers: null, followers_gained: null, followers_lost: null,
    impressions: null, reach: null, views: null, likes: null, comments: null,
    shares: null, saves: null, engagements: null, engagement_rate: null,
    posts_published: null, video_views: null, watch_time: null,
    profile_views: null, link_clicks: null,
    data_status: 'FAILED',
    collected_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    error_message: 'Unsupported platform in Account_Master: ' + (j.Platform || 'unknown'),
    http_status: null,
    operation: 'orchestrator.unsupported_platform',
  },
};

workflowId.cachedResultName: WF7 - Post Discovery / Post Master Sync

nodeGroups.name: Setup
nodeGroups.description: Generate run_id and compute target date (yesterday, Asia/Kolkata).

nodeGroups.name: Read & Filter
nodeGroups.description: Load Account_Master and keep only Active accounts.

nodeGroups.name: Collect per account
nodeGroups.description: Route each account by platform to its collector, error-isolated, and converge normalized results.

nodeGroups.name: Persist daily metrics
nodeGroups.description: Idempotent upsert into Daily_Metrics (Date+Account_ID) and update Last_Sync.

nodeGroups.name: Post metrics
nodeGroups.description: Independent, non-blocking: WF7 discovers posts and syncs Post_Master + 30-day tracking window, then WF5 collects post metrics upserted into Post_

nodeGroups.description: Write API_Log and send a Gmail notification only when failures/partials occur.
